prose: Our most mystically magic of friends Lindsey Scharmyn returns to Vibe Rant, this time to discuss her fictional novel series, Sine Curve of Aeons. The first book in this series, Phi'Telas, will soon be available in audiobook format, narrated by yours truly! In this chat, we'll learn more about Lindsey's life path, connection with spirits, the experience of writing, and more. Lindsey is also the intrepid host of Rogue Ways, a podcast you likely already know and love!
